messages:
Irene K: Quick report from support: customers hitting errors after the migration docs went live. Two hotspots: streaming callback example and an embeddings example pointing to /v1/embeddings.
Ben F: Can you paste the exact failing snippet?
Irene K: Sure — streaming example in docs/migration.md currently shows:
```python
for chunk in client.stream_response(model_name=\"redwood-2\", prompt=\"Hey\"):
    print(chunk.text)
```
This will raise in v2 (param is `model`) and the SDK changed on_token signature.
Aria M: Also the quickstart embeddings calls the old endpoint path: `POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` and expects `model_name`. Needs to be `/v2/embeddings` and `model`.
Ben F: I'll open a patch PR updating both examples, add a short migration checklist, and include an explicit deprecation timeline. PR 1822 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1822
docs-bot: lint: examples/migration.md -> deprecated usage of 'model_name' detected (rule: examples/params).
Irene K: Can we include a temporary compatibility shim for streaming users who can't update right away? Something clearly labeled as temporary.
Aria M: Proposed shim (added to PR):
```python
def stream_compat(client, *args, **kwargs):
    if 'model_name' in kwargs and 'model' not in kwargs:
        kwargs['model'] = kwargs.pop('model_name')
    if 'on_token' in kwargs and kwargs['on_token'].__code__.co_argcount == 1:
        old_cb = kwargs['on_token']
        def new_cb(token, meta=None):
            return old_cb(token)
        kwargs['on_token'] = new_cb
    return client.stream_response(*args, **kwargs)
```
Label: "temporary compatibility shim — remove after migration window". Add security/maintenance caveat.
Ben F: Runtime confirmed: we will accept `model_name` for 14 days and emit a Deprecation header; after that requests receive 422 with an explanatory body. Adding that timeline to the deprecation notice.
preview-bot: deploy preview for PR 1822 is available: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/1822 (snippet-runner tests included).
Irene K: Also updated the Getting Started tutorial link that pointed to the old embeddings snippet. Thanks.
Aria M: CI/snippet-runner passed. I'll do final docs review; just one wording nit on the shim section to stress "not for production".
Ben F: Merged PR 1822. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
